programme.title: Lohe Ke Haath
programme.desc: A woman survives a murderous dowry-related attempt on her life by her husband and mother-in-law. Later, she meets a lady who trains her and other survivors to fight back against systemic injustice.

programme.title: Mangani
programme.desc: Due to her appearance, a woman faces persistent challenges. Subjected to constant ridicule, she is rejected by numerous men, including her college crush.

programme.title: Waqt Ki Deewar
programme.desc: Two brothers are separated after their mother's death. Later, one of them becomes a gangster, and the other becomes a police officer, as they find themselves at odds, unaware of their true relationship.

programme.title: Lohe Ke Haath
programme.desc: A woman survives a murderous dowry-related attempt on her life by her husband and mother-in-law. Later, she meets a lady who trains her and other survivors to fight back against systemic injustice.

programme.title: Bhrashtachar
programme.desc: Journalist Bhavani intends to expose and bring to justice a corrupt politician who pretends to be a social worker. However, she soon finds herself trapped in a web of conspiracies.

programme.title: Hum
programme.desc: A man is determined to kill a cruel businessman to get revenge for his father's death but is stopped by an inspector who is the mastermind behind the troubles.

programme.title: Insaaf Apne Lahoo Se
programme.desc: After his wife passes away, wealthy lawyer Mahendrapratap Singh remarries a widow named Geeta, who has a young son named Devilal. Mahendrapratap dislikes Devilal to such an extent that one day he asks Geeta to choose between her son and him.

programme.title: Hitler
programme.desc: Siddhanth Sharma, a strict disciplinarian, is forced to chase his brother, Amar, after he is accused of murder. However, his wife, Sheila, a lawyer, decides to defend Amar.

programme.title: Himalay Ki God Mein
programme.desc: India 1965; Drama; Dir. Vijay Bhatt; Cast: Mala Sinha, Manoj Kumar. When a doctor is attacked in a remote tribal area, a local woman comes to his aid. He stays & tries to improve medical facilities.

programme.title: Mera Desh Mera Dharam
programme.desc: Sajid, the son of an army officer, joins an armed freedom struggle in a bid to liberate the Bangladeshi populace from the oppressive Pakistani regime. However, his personal life faces turmoil.

programme.title: Animal Atlas
programme.desc: This educational series takes viewers on a journey around the world to meet all kinds of animals, from the familiar to the not-so-familiar. "Animal Atlas" teaches viewers about the animals' lives, histories and adaptations that allow them to survive in their environment. Whether it's visiting monkeys or heading underwater for a look at mammals that live in the ocean, "Animal Atlas" brings animals from around the globe into viewers' homes for an up-close look at how the animals live.

programme.title: Animal Armoury
programme.desc: Only the strongest survive in the animal kingdom, where the competition for food, territory or mates means employing skillfully crafted tricks of the trade. "Animal Armory" incorporates high-end imagery and computer graphics to reveal how wildlife use their teeth, claws, antlers, camouflage, venom and even spit to threaten and intimidate rivals and predators alike. With weapons of deception, animals disarm and entice prey to their death. Meanwhile, perhaps the oldest weapons employed by animals are projectiles, which have evolved into their own versions of poison-tipped harpoons, chemical missiles and high-powered bullets.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dan Short fell in love with cars when he first laid eyes on a 1967 Camaro. He bought a used model as a teenager, but because he couldn't pay someone else to restore it, he learned how to do the work himself. After a stint in the Army, Short decided to make his passion for classic cars his life's work, and FantomWorks was born. Today the Norfolk, Va., company is the largest auto restoration shop in the U.S., and this reality series shows how Short and his team meticulously refurbish some of America's favorite rides. Drama ensues in the form of personality clashes, cost overruns, irate customers and other issues, which are compounded by Short's reputation as a straight shooter who won't accept substandard results.
